policy: Every repo, service, workflow, CI lane, runner pool, Linear team/area, canon doc, data store and control loop has one agent owner and an escalation chain that ends at the one human owner of last resort. Humans are never routine owners. scripts/ownership-registry.mjs enforces it in ci:control:test.

summer.name: Summer
summer.job: Company governor: admission, Linear lifecycle, founder decision cards, canon stewardship.

summer-improvement-loop.name: Summer improvement loop
summer-improvement-loop.job: Managed Agents loop that repairs Summer's runtime and config by PR (never merges, never changes credentials or spend).

gem-ci-repair.name: Gem CI repair (lanes fix loop)
gem-ci-repair.job: Repairs red CI lanes and workflows. Diff defects go to the PR's writer lane via Lane Fix Relay labels; lane or runner defects are fixed here or filed as remediation:<lane>.

gem-lanes.name: Gem lanes (eligibility, dispatch, claims)
gem-lanes.job: Sole writer of scripts/lanes/**: admission, dispatch, started-state ownership (scripts/lanes/ownership.py) and orphaned-claim release.

gem-hostops.name: Gem host operations
gem-hostops.job: Gem host, self-hosted runner pools (including jovie-mac), disk, systemd/launchd units, gbrain host.

symphony-release.name: Symphony release path
symphony-release.job: Staging/production controllers, release, rollback, production verification and production data-store migrations.

zoe.name: Zoe
zoe.job: Personal agent only (hard wall, never Linear). Owns only Tim's personal config repo.

tim.name: Tim White
tim.job: Owner of last resort only: taste, spend, credentials, irreversible calls. Never a routine owner.
